notes: P3 same-application posture challenge. Reference arm/position: seated, left upper arm beside the torso, elbow bent, forearm vertical in a neutral handshake orientation. Keep the frozen four-class P3 model and decision policy unchanged until this recording is scored.

elbow_extended.notes: Let the left arm hang down beside your body with the elbow comfortably nearly straight and the thumb pointing forward. Keep the arm still during every hold.

elbow_flexed.notes: Keep the left elbow beside your body and the forearm horizontal in front of you, with the palm facing the floor. Keep the arm still during every hold.

arm_abducted.notes: Hold the left arm comfortably away from your torso to the side, with the palm facing upward. Choose a sustainable height and keep it unchanged throughout this block.
